---
id: create-capacity-plan
title: "Create a DRAFT CapacityPlan and compute its shortage"
description: "Evaluates the ProcessPath path_id against assigned_demand (orders) for the warehouse's location over [window_start, window_end): loads each step's ProcessCapacity, normalizes it with the WorkloadProfile factors supplied in the body (same shape and validation as GET /process-paths/{id}/capacity -- there is no WorkloadProfile persistence yet), and computes path_capacity (ORDER per HOUR), bottleneck_step, capacity_over_window (path_capacity x window hours) and shortage (max(0, assigned_demand - capacity_over_window), never negative). The window is both the plan's planning window AND the window every step's ProcessCapacity is looked up for: a registered window applies to a step when it COVERS [window_start, window_end), exactly as in GET /process-paths/{id}/capacity (docs/adr/0003). The plan stores its own requested window. assigned_demand arrives in the request -- a documented Phase 4 simplification (the final demand ingestion from order-management / network-fulfillment is a later decision; this context never makes a live cross-context call). The plan is saved and its CapacityPlanCreated event is queued in the transactional outbox in ONE database transaction."

Evaluates the ProcessPath path_id against assigned_demand (orders) for the warehouse's location over [window_start, window_end): loads each step's ProcessCapacity, normalizes it with the WorkloadProfile factors supplied in the body (same shape and validation as GET /process-paths/\{id\}/capacity -- there is no WorkloadProfile persistence yet), and computes path_capacity (ORDER per HOUR), bottleneck_step, capacity_over_window (path_capacity x window hours) and shortage (max(0, assigned_demand - capacity_over_window), never negative). The window is both the plan's planning window AND the window every step's ProcessCapacity is looked up for: a registered window applies to a step when it COVERS [window_start, window_end), exactly as in GET /process-paths/\{id\}/capacity (docs/adr/0003). The plan stores its own requested window. assigned_demand arrives in the request -- a documented Phase 4 simplification (the final demand ingestion from order-management / network-fulfillment is a later decision; this context never makes a live cross-context call). The plan is saved and its CapacityPlanCreated event is queued in the transactional outbox in ONE database transaction.
